facets.description: Facet field names to arrays of value and count. Keys may include: `redocly_category`, `redocly_product`, `redocly_version`, `redocly_teams`, `httpMethod`, `httpPath`, `apiTitle`, `apiVersion`, and any custom facet fields.

documents.description: Category names (e.g. Documentation, API Reference) to arrays of search items.

value.description: Facet value (for example: a category or product name).

count.description: Number of search results that match this facet value.

SearchDocument.description: Indexed document returned in search results.

id.description: Unique identifier of the indexed document.

url.description: URL of the document or API operation.

text.description: Indexed text content used for search matching.

path.description: Breadcrumb path (for example: section titles) leading to this document.

redocly_category.description: Documentation category (for example: Documentation, API Reference).

redocly_product.description: Product name when content is scoped by product.

redocly_teams.description: Team names when content is scoped by team.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default version.

redocly_version.description: Version label or version object for versioned content.

httpMethod.description: HTTP method (for example: GET, POST) for API reference items.

httpPath.description: HTTP path pattern for API reference items.

apiTitle.description: Title of the API for API reference items.

apiVersion.description: API version for API reference items.

SearchHighlight.description: Highlighted snippets; matched terms are wrapped in `<mark>` tags.

id.description: Document ID matching the result document.

title.description: Highlighted title snippet with matched terms in `<mark>` tags.

text.description: Highlighted content snippet with matched terms in `<mark>` tags.

redocly_category.description: Category value for this result (for example: Documentation, API Reference).

redocly_product.description: Product value for this result when applicable.

document.description: The indexed document (metadata and content fields).
